function Write-LabLog {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Message)
    $line = '{0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} [{1}] {2}' -f (Get-Date), $Phase, $Message
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line
    Write-Information -MessageData $line -InformationAction Continue
}

function ConvertFrom-Base64String {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Value)
    [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($Value))
}

function Invoke-WithRetry {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][scriptblock] $ScriptBlock,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Activity,
        [int] $Attempts = 3,
        [int] $DelaySeconds = 30
    )
    for ($i = 1; $i -le $Attempts; $i++) {
        try {
            return & $ScriptBlock
        }
        catch {
            Write-LabLog "$Activity - Versuch $i/$Attempts fehlgeschlagen: $($_.Exception.Message)"
            if ($i -eq $Attempts) { throw }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds $DelaySeconds
        }
    }
}

function Write-Utf8File {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Path, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Content)
    # Mit BOM, damit Windows PowerShell 5.1 Umlaute korrekt liest.
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, (New-Object -TypeName System.Text.UTF8Encoding -ArgumentList $true))
}

function Protect-Directory {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Path)
    New-Item -Path $Path -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
    & icacls.exe $Path /inheritance:r /grant:r '*S-1-5-32-544:(OI)(CI)F' '*S-1-5-18:(OI)(CI)F' | Out-Null
}

function Register-LabUpdateTask {
    # Wird lokal und per Invoke-Command auf dem DC ausgefuehrt, daher ohne Abhaengigkeiten.
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $ScriptContent,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $TaskName,
        [bool] $StartNow = $false
    )
    $scriptFolder = 'C:\ExchangeLab\Scripts'
    New-Item -Path $scriptFolder -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
    $scriptPath = Join-Path $scriptFolder 'Update-LabServer.ps1'
    Set-Content -Path $scriptPath -Value $ScriptContent -Encoding ASCII

    $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument "-NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$scriptPath`" -TaskName $TaskName"
    $trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtStartup
    $trigger.Delay = 'PT5M'
    $principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId 'SYSTEM' -LogonType ServiceAccount -RunLevel Highest
    $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Hours 4) -StartWhenAvailable
    Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -Principal $principal -Settings $settings -Force | Out-Null
    if ($StartNow) {
        Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName
    }
}

#region Phase Orchestrate

function Get-PendingRebootReason {
    $reasons = @()
    if (Test-Path -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Component Based Servicing\RebootPending') {
        $reasons += 'Component Based Servicing'
    }
    if (Test-Path -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WindowsUpdate\Auto Update\RebootRequired') {
        $reasons += 'Windows Update'
    }
    if (Test-Path -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Netlogon\JoinDomain') {
        $reasons += 'Domaenenbeitritt'
    }
    return $reasons
}

function Wait-DomainJoinComplete {
    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(30)
    while ($true) {
        $computerSystem = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ComputerSystem
        $joinPending = Test-Path -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Netlogon\JoinDomain'
        $secureChannel = $false
        if ($computerSystem.PartOfDomain -and -not $joinPending) {
            try { $secureChannel = Test-ComputerSecureChannel } catch { $secureChannel = $false }
        }
        if ($secureChannel) {
            Write-LabLog "Domaenenbeitritt zu $($computerSystem.Domain) abgeschlossen, Secure Channel ok."
            return
        }
        if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) {
            throw 'Domaenenbeitritt nach 30 Minuten nicht abgeschlossen.'
        }
        Write-LabLog "Warte auf Domaenenbeitritt (Teil der Domain: $($computerSystem.PartOfDomain), Neustart ausstehend: $joinPending)."
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 20
    }
}

function Save-InstallSecret {
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Security
    Protect-Directory -Path $SecretDir
    $payload = @{
        AdminPassword   = ConvertFrom-Base64String $AdminPasswordB64
        LabUserPassword = ConvertFrom-Base64String $LabUserPasswordB64
    } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
    $protected = [Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]::Protect([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($payload), $null, [Security.Cryptography.DataProtectionScope]::LocalMachine)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($SecretFile, $protected)
}

function Save-OwnScript {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Destination)
    if ($PSCommandPath -and (Test-Path -Path $PSCommandPath)) {
        Copy-Item -Path $PSCommandPath -Destination $Destination -Force
    }
    else {
        Set-Content -Path $Destination -Value $SelfText -Encoding ASCII
    }
}

function Invoke-InstallTask {
    $scriptCopy = Join-Path $ScriptDir 'Install-ExchangeServer.ps1'
    Save-OwnScript -Destination $scriptCopy
    Write-Utf8File -Path $LabUsersFile -Content (ConvertFrom-Base64String $LabUsersB64)
    Write-Utf8File -Path $UpdateScriptFile -Content (ConvertFrom-Base64String $UpdateScriptB64)
    Write-Utf8File -Path $MaintenanceScriptFile -Content (ConvertFrom-Base64String $MaintenanceScriptB64)
    Save-InstallSecret
    Remove-Item -Path $ResultFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    $arguments = '-NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "{0}" -Phase Install -DomainName {1} -NetbiosName {2} -AdminUser {3} -PublicDomainName {4} -CompanyOu {5} -DcComputerName {6} -OrganizationName {7}' -f $scriptCopy, $DomainName, $NetbiosName, $AdminUser, $PublicDomainName, $CompanyOu, $DcComputerName, $OrganizationName
    if ($SecondDcComputerName) {
        $arguments += " -SecondDcComputerName $SecondDcComputerName"
    }
    if ($ClientComputerName) {
        $arguments += " -ClientComputerName $ClientComputerName"
    }
    if ($FileServerComputerName) {
        $arguments += " -FileServerComputerName $FileServerComputerName"
    }
    $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument $arguments
    $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Hours 3)
    $adminPassword = ConvertFrom-Base64String $AdminPasswordB64
    Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $InstallTaskName -Action $action -Settings $settings -User "$NetbiosName\$AdminUser" -Password $adminPassword -RunLevel Highest -Force | Out-Null
    Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $InstallTaskName
    Write-LabLog "Installationsphase als $NetbiosName\$AdminUser gestartet (Task $InstallTaskName)."

    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes($TimeoutMinutes)
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 30
    while ((Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $InstallTaskName).State -eq 'Running') {
        if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) {
            Stop-ScheduledTask -TaskName $InstallTaskName
            throw "Installationsphase nach $TimeoutMinutes Minuten abgebrochen."
        }
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 30
    }

    $taskInfo = Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $InstallTaskName
    Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $InstallTaskName -Confirm:$false
    Remove-Item -Path $SecretFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    $result = if (Test-Path -Path $ResultFile) { (Get-Content -Path $ResultFile -Raw).Trim() } else { 'missing' }
    if ($result -ne '0') {
        $installLog = Join-Path $LogDir 'Install-ExchangeServer-Install.log'
        $tail = Get-Content -Path $installLog -Tail 40 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        throw "Installationsphase fehlgeschlagen (Ergebnis $result, Task-Code $($taskInfo.LastTaskResult)).`n$($tail -join "`n")"
    }
}

function Invoke-OrchestratePhase {
    if (Test-Path -Path $DoneMarker) {
        Write-LabLog 'Exchange ist bereits installiert und konfiguriert, nichts zu tun.'
        return
    }
    foreach ($name in 'AdminPasswordB64', 'LabUserPasswordB64', 'LabUsersB64', 'UpdateScriptB64', 'MaintenanceScriptB64') {
        if (-not (Get-Variable -Name $name -ValueOnly)) {
            throw "Parameter $name fehlt."
        }
    }

    Wait-DomainJoinComplete
    $pending = Get-PendingRebootReason
    if ($pending) {
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: Neustart ausstehend ($($pending -join ', ')). Exchange-Setup prueft das selbst."
    }

    Invoke-InstallTask

    Set-Content -Path $DoneMarker -Value (Get-Date -Format o) -Encoding ASCII
    Write-LabLog 'Exchange installiert und konfiguriert. Neustart in 120 Sekunden, danach Update-Lauf.'
    & shutdown.exe /r /t 120 /c 'ExchangeLab: Neustart nach Exchange-Installation' /d p:4:2 | Out-Null
}

function Initialize-LabDirectory {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][securestring] $LabUserPassword)

    Import-Module ActiveDirectory
    $forest = Get-ADForest
    if ($forest.UPNSuffixes -notcontains $PublicDomainName) {
        Set-ADForest -Identity $forest -UPNSuffixes @{ Add = $PublicDomainName }
        Write-LabLog "UPN-Suffix $PublicDomainName hinzugefuegt."
    }

    $domainDn = (Get-ADDomain).DistinguishedName
    $companyDn = "OU=$CompanyOu,$domainDn"
    if (-not [adsi]::Exists("LDAP://$companyDn")) {
        New-ADOrganizationalUnit -Name $CompanyOu -Path $domainDn
        Write-LabLog "OU $companyDn angelegt."
    }

    $data = Import-PowerShellDataFile -Path $LabUsersFile
    foreach ($relativeOu in $data.OrganizationalUnits) {
        $ouDn = "$relativeOu,$companyDn"
        if ([adsi]::Exists("LDAP://$ouDn")) { continue }
        $parts = $relativeOu -split ',', 2
        $name = $parts[0] -replace '^OU=', ''
        $parentDn = if ($parts.Count -gt 1) { "$($parts[1]),$companyDn" } else { $companyDn }
        New-ADOrganizationalUnit -Name $name -Path $parentDn
        Write-LabLog "OU $ouDn angelegt."
    }

    foreach ($user in $data.Users) {
        $displayName = "$($user.GivenName) $($user.Surname)"
        $attributes = @{
            GivenName         = $user.GivenName
            Surname           = $user.Surname
            DisplayName       = $displayName
            UserPrincipalName = '{0}@{1}' -f $user.SamAccountName.ToLowerInvariant(), $PublicDomainName
            StreetAddress     = $user.StreetAddress
            City              = $user.City
            PostalCode        = $user.PostalCode
            Country           = 'DE'
            Company           = $CompanyOu
            Office            = $user.Office
            Title             = $user.Title
            OfficePhone       = $user.OfficePhone
            MobilePhone       = $user.MobilePhone
            # Lab-Kompromiss: Ohne das laeuft das Kennwort nach 42 Tagen (Default Domain Policy) ab.
            PasswordNeverExpires = $true
        }
        if ($user.Department) { $attributes.Department = $user.Department }

        $existing = Get-ADUser -Filter "SamAccountName -eq '$($user.SamAccountName)'"
        if ($existing) {
            Set-ADUser -Identity $existing @attributes
        }
        else {
            New-ADUser -Name $displayName -SamAccountName $user.SamAccountName -Path "$($user.OrganizationalUnit),$companyDn" -AccountPassword $LabUserPassword -Enabled $true @attributes
            Write-LabLog "Benutzer $($user.SamAccountName) angelegt."
        }
    }

    # Zweiter Durchlauf, weil Vorgesetzte erst existieren muessen.
    if ($data.Managers) {
        foreach ($entry in $data.Managers.GetEnumerator()) {
            Set-ADUser -Identity $entry.Key -Manager $entry.Value
        }
        Write-LabLog "Vorgesetzte fuer $($data.Managers.Count) Benutzer gesetzt."
    }

    Set-ADUser -Identity $AdminUser -PasswordNeverExpires $true
    Write-LabLog "Kennwortablauf fuer $AdminUser und die Lab-Benutzer deaktiviert."
    return $data
}

function Assert-DomainControllerBuild {
    $dcFqdn = "$DcComputerName.$DomainName"
    try {
        $build = Invoke-Command -ComputerName $dcFqdn -ScriptBlock {
            $currentVersion = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion'
            [pscustomobject]@{ Build = [int]$currentVersion.CurrentBuildNumber; Ubr = [int]$currentVersion.UBR }
        }
    }
    catch {
        # Nur die Pruefung entfaellt; Marketplace-Images "latest" erfuellen die Bedingung.
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: Build des DC $dcFqdn nicht pruefbar: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        return
    }
    Write-LabLog "DC $dcFqdn hat Build $($build.Build).$($build.Ubr)."
    if ($build.Build -eq 26100 -and $build.Ubr -lt 7171) {
        throw "DC $dcFqdn braucht fuer PrepareSchema mindestens Build 26100.7171 (Update November 2025)."
    }
}

function Invoke-ExchangeSetup {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Step, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string[]] $Arguments)

    $setupExe = Join-Path $MediaDir 'Setup.exe'
    $allArguments = $Arguments + '/IAcceptExchangeServerLicenseTerms_DiagnosticDataOFF'
    $outFile = Join-Path $LogDir "ExchangeSetup-$Step.out.log"
    Write-LabLog "Exchange-Setup ${Step}: $($allArguments -join ' ')"
    $process = Start-Process -FilePath $setupExe -ArgumentList $allArguments -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $outFile -RedirectStandardError "$outFile.err"
    if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        $tail = Get-Content -Path 'C:\ExchangeSetupLogs\ExchangeSetup.log' -Tail 30 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        throw "Exchange-Setup $Step mit Exit-Code $($process.ExitCode) beendet.`n$($tail -join "`n")"
    }
    Write-LabLog "Exchange-Setup $Step erfolgreich."
}

function Install-Exchange {
    if (Get-Service -Name MSExchangeIS -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {

    Assert-DomainControllerBuild
    Invoke-ExchangeSetup -Step 'PrepareSchema' -Arguments '/PrepareSchema'
    Invoke-ExchangeSetup -Step 'PrepareAD' -Arguments '/PrepareAD', "/OrganizationName:$OrganizationName"
    Invoke-ExchangeSetup -Step 'Install' -Arguments '/Mode:Install', '/Roles:Mailbox', '/MdbName:DB01', '/DbFilePath:F:\ExchangeDatabases\DB01\DB01.edb', '/LogFolderPath:F:\ExchangeDatabases\DB01\Logs'
}

function Initialize-ExchangeConfiguration {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][object[]] $Users)

    $server = $env:COMPUTERNAME
    $mailHost = "mail.$PublicDomainName"
    $baseUrl = "https://$mailHost"

    # Accepted Domain und Adressrichtlinie
    if (-not (Get-AcceptedDomain | Where-Object { "$($_.DomainName)" -eq $PublicDomainName })) {
        New-AcceptedDomain -Name $PublicDomainName -DomainName $PublicDomainName -DomainType Authoritative | Out-Null
    }
    Set-AcceptedDomain -Identity $PublicDomainName -MakeDefault $true
    $policy = Get-EmailAddressPolicy | Where-Object { "$($_.Priority)" -eq 'Lowest' } | Select-Object -First 1
    Set-EmailAddressPolicy -Identity $policy.Name -EnabledEmailAddressTemplates "SMTP:%m@$PublicDomainName", "smtp:%m@$DomainName"
    Update-EmailAddressPolicy -Identity $policy.Name
    Write-LabLog "Accepted Domain $PublicDomainName ist Standard, Adressrichtlinie '$($policy.Name)' angewendet."

    # Postfaecher
    $database = (Get-MailboxDatabase -Server $server | Select-Object -First 1).Name
    foreach ($user in $Users) {
        $upn = '{0}@{1}' -f $user.SamAccountName.ToLowerInvariant(), $PublicDomainName
        $recipient = Get-User -Identity $upn
        if ("$($recipient.RecipientType)" -ne 'UserMailbox') {
            Invoke-WithRetry -Activity "Enable-Mailbox $upn" -Attempts 5 -DelaySeconds 30 -ScriptBlock {
                Enable-Mailbox -Identity $upn -Database $database | Out-Null
            }
            Write-LabLog "Postfach fuer $upn angelegt."
        }
    }

    # Zertifikat
    $pfxFile = Join-Path $CertDir 'fullchain.pfx'
    if (Test-Path -Path $pfxFile) {
        $certificate = New-Object -TypeName System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2 -ArgumentList $pfxFile, $PfxPassword
        $thumbprint = $certificate.Thumbprint
        if (-not (Get-ExchangeCertificate -Server $server | Where-Object { $_.Thumbprint -eq $thumbprint })) {
            Import-ExchangeCertificate -Server $server -FileData ([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($pfxFile)) -Password (ConvertTo-SecureString -String $PfxPassword -AsPlainText -Force) -PrivateKeyExportable $true | Out-Null
        }
        Enable-ExchangeCertificate -Server $server -Thumbprint $thumbprint -Services 'IIS,SMTP' -Force -Confirm:$false
        Write-LabLog "Zertifikat $($certificate.Subject) ($thumbprint, gueltig bis $($certificate.NotAfter)) fuer IIS und SMTP aktiviert."
    }
    else {
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: $pfxFile fehlt, Exchange nutzt weiter das selbstsignierte Zertifikat."
    }

    # Interne und externe URLs
    Set-OwaVirtualDirectory -Identity "$server\owa (Default Web Site)" -InternalUrl "$baseUrl/owa" -ExternalUrl "$baseUrl/owa"
    Set-EcpVirtualDirectory -Identity "$server\ecp (Default Web Site)" -InternalUrl "$baseUrl/ecp" -ExternalUrl "$baseUrl/ecp"
    Set-WebServicesVirtualDirectory -Identity "$server\EWS (Default Web Site)" -InternalUrl "$baseUrl/EWS/Exchange.asmx" -ExternalUrl "$baseUrl/EWS/Exchange.asmx"
    Set-OabVirtualDirectory -Identity "$server\OAB (Default Web Site)" -InternalUrl "$baseUrl/OAB" -ExternalUrl "$baseUrl/OAB"
    Set-ActiveSyncVirtualDirectory -Identity "$server\Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync (Default Web Site)" -InternalUrl "$baseUrl/Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync" -ExternalUrl "$baseUrl/Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync"
    Set-MapiVirtualDirectory -Identity "$server\mapi (Default Web Site)" -InternalUrl "$baseUrl/mapi" -ExternalUrl "$baseUrl/mapi"
    # Mit ExternalHostname verlangt Exchange eine externe Authentifizierungsmethode; vorhandene beibehalten.
    $outlookAnywhere = Get-OutlookAnywhere -Identity "$server\Rpc (Default Web Site)"
    $externalAuth = "$($outlookAnywhere.ExternalClientAuthenticationMethod)"
    if (-not $externalAuth) { $externalAuth = 'Ntlm' }
    Set-OutlookAnywhere -Identity "$server\Rpc (Default Web Site)" -InternalHostname $mailHost -ExternalHostname $mailHost -InternalClientsRequireSsl $true -ExternalClientsRequireSsl $true -ExternalClientAuthenticationMethod $externalAuth
    Set-ClientAccessService -Identity $server -AutoDiscoverServiceInternalUri "https://autodiscover.$PublicDomainName/Autodiscover/Autodiscover.xml"
    Write-LabLog "Interne und externe URLs auf $baseUrl gesetzt, Autodiscover-SCP konfiguriert."
}

function Initialize-LabRecipient {
    # Beispielempfaenger fuer die Uebungen. Bestehende Objekte bleiben unveraendert, fehlende Berechtigungen
    # werden ergaenzt. Nicht fatal: Die Beispiele duerfen die Exchange-Installation nicht scheitern lassen.
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][hashtable] $LabData)

    try {
        $companyDn = "OU=$CompanyOu,$((Get-ADDomain).DistinguishedName)"
        $database = (Get-MailboxDatabase -Server $env:COMPUTERNAME | Select-Object -First 1).Name

        foreach ($group in $LabData.DistributionGroups) {
            if (Get-LabRecipientByAlias -Alias $group.Alias) { continue }
            New-DistributionGroup -Name $group.Name -Alias $group.Alias -SamAccountName $group.Alias -Type Distribution -OrganizationalUnit "$($group.OrganizationalUnit),$companyDn" -Members $group.Members | Out-Null
            Write-LabLog "Verteiler $($group.Alias) mit $($group.Members.Count) Mitgliedern angelegt."
        }

        foreach ($shared in $LabData.SharedMailboxes) {
            if (-not (Get-LabRecipientByAlias -Alias $shared.Alias)) {
                Invoke-WithRetry -Activity "Freigegebenes Postfach $($shared.Alias)" -Attempts 5 -DelaySeconds 30 -ScriptBlock {
                    New-Mailbox -Shared -Name $shared.Name -Alias $shared.Alias -SamAccountName $shared.Alias -OrganizationalUnit "$($shared.OrganizationalUnit),$companyDn" -Database $database | Out-Null
                }
                Write-LabLog "Freigegebenes Postfach $($shared.Alias) angelegt."
            }
            foreach ($user in $shared.FullAccess) {
                $existing = Get-MailboxPermission -Identity $shared.Alias -User $user -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { "$($_.AccessRights)" -match 'FullAccess' }
                if (-not $existing) {
                    # AutoMapping: Outlook blendet das Postfach beim Benutzer automatisch ein.
                    Add-MailboxPermission -Identity $shared.Alias -User $user -AccessRights FullAccess -InheritanceType All -AutoMapping $true | Out-Null
                    Write-LabLog "Vollzugriff auf $($shared.Alias) fuer $user."
                }
            }
            $mailboxDn = (Get-Mailbox -Identity $shared.Alias).DistinguishedName
            foreach ($user in $shared.SendAs) {
                $existing = Get-ADPermission -Identity $mailboxDn -User $user -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { "$($_.ExtendedRights)" -match 'Send-As' }
                if (-not $existing) {
                    Add-ADPermission -Identity $mailboxDn -User $user -ExtendedRights 'Send As' | Out-Null
                    Write-LabLog "Senden als $($shared.Alias) fuer $user."
                }
            }
        }

        foreach ($room in $LabData.RoomMailboxes) {
            if (Get-LabRecipientByAlias -Alias $room.Alias) { continue }
            Invoke-WithRetry -Activity "Raumpostfach $($room.Alias)" -Attempts 5 -DelaySeconds 30 -ScriptBlock {
                New-Mailbox -Room -Name $room.Name -Alias $room.Alias -SamAccountName $room.Alias -OrganizationalUnit "$($room.OrganizationalUnit),$companyDn" -Database $database | Out-Null
            }
            Invoke-WithRetry -Activity "Kapazitaet $($room.Alias)" -Attempts 5 -DelaySeconds 30 -ScriptBlock {
                Set-Mailbox -Identity $room.Alias -ResourceCapacity $room.Capacity
            }
            Write-LabLog "Raumpostfach $($room.Alias) (Kapazitaet $($room.Capacity)) angelegt."
        }

        foreach ($contact in $LabData.Contacts) {
            if (Get-LabRecipientByAlias -Alias $contact.Alias) { continue }
            New-MailContact -Name $contact.Name -Alias $contact.Alias -ExternalEmailAddress $contact.ExternalEmailAddress -OrganizationalUnit "$($contact.OrganizationalUnit),$companyDn" | Out-Null
            Write-LabLog "Kontakt $($contact.Alias) angelegt."
        }
    }
    catch {
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: Beispielempfaenger unvollstaendig: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
}

function Register-LabMaintenance {
    $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument "-NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$MaintenanceScriptFile`""
    # Nachts ist die VM meist aus (Auto-Shutdown): mittags plus StartWhenAvailable holt verpasste Laeufe nach.
    $trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Daily -At '12:00'
    $principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId 'SYSTEM' -LogonType ServiceAccount -RunLevel Highest
    $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Hours 1) -StartWhenAvailable
    Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $MaintenanceTaskName -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -Principal $principal -Settings $settings -Force | Out-Null
    Write-LabLog "Wartungs-Task $MaintenanceTaskName registriert (taeglich 12:00, Log-Bereinigung und Zertifikatserneuerung)."
}

function Initialize-LabOutlookPolicy {
    # Das neue Outlook fuer Windows unterstuetzt kein Exchange on Premises. Die GPO blendet den Umschalter
    # im klassischen Outlook aus und schaltet die automatische Migration ab. Nicht fatal.
    $name = 'LAB - Outlook klassisch'
    try {
        Import-Module -Name GroupPolicy
        if (-not (Get-GPO -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
            New-GPO -Name $name -Comment 'Exchange-Lab: neues Outlook ausblenden, klassisches Outlook fuer Exchange on Premises behalten.' | Out-Null
            Write-LabLog "GPO '$name' angelegt."
        }
        Set-GPRegistryValue -Name $name -Key 'HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\office\16.0\outlook\options\general' -ValueName 'HideNewOutlookToggle' -Type DWord -Value 1 | Out-Null
        Set-GPRegistryValue -Name $name -Key 'HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\office\16.0\outlook\preferences' -ValueName 'NewOutlookMigrationUserSetting' -Type DWord -Value 0 | Out-Null

        $target = "OU=$CompanyOu,$((Get-ADDomain).DistinguishedName)"
        if (-not ((Get-GPInheritance -Target $target).GpoLinks | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -eq $name })) {
            New-GPLink -Name $name -Target $target | Out-Null
            Write-LabLog "GPO '$name' mit $target verknuepft."
        }
    }
    catch {
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: GPO '$name' nicht vollstaendig eingerichtet: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
}

function Move-LabClientComputer {
    # Der Client tritt parallel zur Exchange-Installation in den Standardcontainer bei und landet hier in
    # der Lab-Struktur, damit Gruppenrichtlinien der Firmen-OU greifen. Nicht fatal.
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][hashtable] $LabData)

    if (-not $ClientComputerName) { return }
    try {
        $target = "$($LabData.ClientOrganizationalUnit),OU=$CompanyOu,$((Get-ADDomain).DistinguishedName)"
        $computer = $null
        for ($i = 1; $i -le 20 -and -not $computer; $i++) {
            $computer = Get-ADComputer -Filter "Name -eq '$ClientComputerName'"
            if (-not $computer) {
                Write-LabLog "Client $ClientComputerName noch nicht in der Domain, warte (Versuch $i/20)."
                Start-Sleep -Seconds 30
            }
        }
        if (-not $computer) {
            Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: Client $ClientComputerName nicht gefunden, bitte selbst nach $target verschieben."
            return
        }
        if ($computer.DistinguishedName -like "*,$target") {
            Write-LabLog "Client $ClientComputerName liegt bereits in $target."
            return
        }
        Move-ADObject -Identity $computer.DistinguishedName -TargetPath $target
        Write-LabLog "Client $ClientComputerName nach $target verschoben."
    }
    catch {
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: Client $ClientComputerName nicht verschoben: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
}

function Register-LabPtrRecord {
    # Azure-DHCP traegt keine PTR-Records ein, und Windows ueberlaesst sie bei DHCP-Adaptern dem DHCP-Server.
    # Die Reverse-Zone bliebe leer (im Testdeployment nachgewiesen). Deshalb hier fuer alle Lab-Rechner aus
    # deren A-Records in der AD-Zone. Laeuft am Ende, wenn alle VMs registriert sind. Nicht fatal.
    try {
        Import-Module -Name DnsServer
        $dnsServer = "$DcComputerName.$DomainName"
        $ownIp = (Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '127.*' -and $_.IPAddress -notlike '169.254.*' } | Select-Object -First 1).IPAddress
        $octets = $ownIp.Split('.')
        $prefix = '{0}.{1}.{2}.' -f $octets[0], $octets[1], $octets[2]
        $zone = '{0}.{1}.{2}.in-addr.arpa' -f $octets[2], $octets[1], $octets[0]

        $records = Get-DnsServerResourceRecord -ComputerName $dnsServer -ZoneName $DomainName -RRType A |
            Where-Object { $_.HostName -notin '@', 'DomainDnsZones', 'ForestDnsZones' -and $_.RecordData.IPv4Address.IPAddressToString -like "$prefix*" }
        foreach ($record in $records) {
            $ip = $record.RecordData.IPv4Address.IPAddressToString
            $name = $ip.Split('.')[3]
            if (Get-DnsServerResourceRecord -ComputerName $dnsServer -ZoneName $zone -Name $name -RRType Ptr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
                continue
            }
            $fqdn = ('{0}.{1}.' -f $record.HostName, $DomainName).ToLowerInvariant()
            Add-DnsServerResourceRecordPtr -ComputerName $dnsServer -ZoneName $zone -Name $name -PtrDomainName $fqdn
            Write-LabLog "PTR-Record $ip -> $fqdn angelegt."
        }
    }
    catch {
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: PTR-Records nicht vollstaendig angelegt: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
}

function Invoke-InstallPhase {
    $secret = Get-InstallSecret
    $labData = Initialize-LabDirectory -LabUserPassword (ConvertTo-SecureString -String $secret.LabUserPassword -AsPlainText -Force)
    Enable-AdRecycleBin
    Install-Exchange
    Connect-ExchangeSession
    Initialize-ExchangeConfiguration -Users $labData.Users
    Initialize-LabRecipient -LabData $labData
    Initialize-LabOutlookPolicy
    Register-InitialUpdate
    Register-LabMaintenance
    Move-LabClientComputer -LabData $labData
    Register-LabPtrRecord
    Publish-LabDesktop -LabData $labData
}

#endregion

try {
    Write-LabLog "Start (Domain $DomainName, oeffentliche Domain $PublicDomainName)."
    switch ($Phase) {
        'Orchestrate' { Invoke-OrchestratePhase }
        'Install' {
            Invoke-InstallPhase
            Set-Content -Path $ResultFile -Value '0' -Encoding ASCII
        }
    }
    Write-LabLog 'Ende ohne Fehler.'
    exit 0
}
catch {
    Write-LabLog "FEHLER: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    Write-LabLog $_.ScriptStackTrace
    if ($Phase -eq 'Install') {
        Set-Content -Path $ResultFile -Value '1' -Encoding ASCII
    }
    exit 1
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Installiert einmalig alle verfuegbaren Updates (Windows und Microsoft Update inkl. Exchange-SU).

.DESCRIPTION
    Wird nach der Exchange-Installation als Startup-Task (SYSTEM) auf DC und Exchange-Server registriert.
    Nutzt die Windows-Update-COM-API, registriert vorher den Microsoft-Update-Dienst (fuer Exchange-SUs).
    Startet bei Bedarf neu und laeuft dann erneut, maximal MaxRuns-mal. Danach entfernt sich der Task.
    Weitere Updates sind danach Aufgabe der Administratoren (Patch-Modus der VMs ist 'Manual').

    Das Skript enthaelt bewusst nur ASCII-Zeichen (Windows PowerShell 5.1).
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string] $TaskName = 'ExchangeLab-InitialUpdates',

    [int] $MaxRuns = 4
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$LabRoot = 'C:\ExchangeLab'
$LogDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Logs'
$CounterFile = Join-Path $LabRoot 'update-runs.txt'
$MicrosoftUpdateServiceId = '7971f918-a847-4430-9279-4a52d1efe18d'

New-Item -Path $LogDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
$LogFile = Join-Path $LogDir 'Update-LabServer.log'

function Write-LabLog {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Message)
    $line = '{0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} {1}' -f (Get-Date), $Message
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line
    Write-Information -MessageData $line -InformationAction Continue
}

function Unregister-UpdateTask {
    Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Write-LabLog "Task $TaskName entfernt."
}

try {
    $run = 1
    if (Test-Path -Path $CounterFile) {
        $run = [int](Get-Content -Path $CounterFile -Raw) + 1
    }
    Set-Content -Path $CounterFile -Value $run -Encoding ASCII
    if ($run -gt $MaxRuns) {
        Write-LabLog "Maximale Anzahl Durchlaeufe ($MaxRuns) erreicht."
        Unregister-UpdateTask
        exit 0
    }
    Write-LabLog "Update-Durchlauf $run von maximal $MaxRuns."

    $serviceManager = New-Object -ComObject Microsoft.Update.ServiceManager
    $registered = @($serviceManager.Services | Where-Object { $_.ServiceID -eq $MicrosoftUpdateServiceId })
    if (-not $registered) {
        $serviceManager.AddService2($MicrosoftUpdateServiceId, 7, '') | Out-Null
        Write-LabLog 'Microsoft-Update-Dienst registriert.'
    }

    $session = New-Object -ComObject Microsoft.Update.Session
    $searcher = $session.CreateUpdateSearcher()
    $searcher.ServerSelection = 3
    $searcher.ServiceID = $MicrosoftUpdateServiceId

    # Ohne Neustartbedarf sofort erneut suchen: manche Updates erscheinen erst nach anderen.
    for ($round = 1; $round -le 3; $round++) {
        $searchResult = $searcher.Search("IsInstalled=0 and IsHidden=0 and Type='Software'")
        if ($searchResult.Updates.Count -eq 0) {
            Write-LabLog 'Keine ausstehenden Updates.'
            Unregister-UpdateTask
            exit 0
        }

        $updates = New-Object -ComObject Microsoft.Update.UpdateColl
        foreach ($update in $searchResult.Updates) {
            if (-not $update.EulaAccepted) {
                $update.AcceptEula()
            }
            Write-LabLog "Gefunden: $($update.Title)"
            $updates.Add($update) | Out-Null
        }

        $downloader = $session.CreateUpdateDownloader()
        $downloader.Updates = $updates
        $downloader.Download() | Out-Null

        $installer = $session.CreateUpdateInstaller()
        $installer.Updates = $updates
        $installResult = $installer.Install()
        Write-LabLog "Installation beendet, ResultCode $($installResult.ResultCode), Neustart erforderlich: $($installResult.RebootRequired)."

        if ($installResult.RebootRequired) {
            Write-LabLog 'Neustart in 60 Sekunden, danach naechster Durchlauf.'
            & shutdown.exe /r /t 60 /c 'ExchangeLab: Neustart nach Updates' /d p:2:17 | Out-Null
            exit 0
        }
    }
    Write-LabLog 'Weitere Updates stehen aus, naechster Durchlauf beim naechsten Start.'
    exit 0
}
catch {
    Write-LabLog "FEHLER: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    exit 1
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Taegliche Wartung des Exchange-Servers im Lab: Log-Bereinigung und Zertifikatserneuerung.

.DESCRIPTION
    Wird nach der Exchange-Installation als Scheduled Task (SYSTEM) registriert. Laeuft taeglich um 12:00;
    ist die VM dann aus (Auto-Shutdown), holt StartWhenAvailable den Lauf nach dem naechsten Start nach.

      - Log-Bereinigung: loescht *.log, *.blg und *.etl aelter als RetentionDays in den IIS-Logs,
        im Exchange-Ordner Logging und in den Diagnose-Traces der Suche. Message-Tracking-Logs liegen
        unter TransportRoles und bleiben unberuehrt (eigene Aufbewahrung, Uebungsthema).
      - Zertifikat: erneuert das Let's-Encrypt-Zertifikat per Posh-ACME, sobald es faellig ist, kopiert
        die Dateien nach C:\Certificates und bindet es an IIS und SMTP. Die Exchange-Cmdlets kommen aus
        dem lokalen Snap-in, weil SYSTEM keine Remote-PowerShell-Sitzung mit RBAC-Rechten bekommt.

    Das Skript enthaelt bewusst nur ASCII-Zeichen (Windows PowerShell 5.1).
#>
[Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSAvoidUsingConvertToSecureStringWithPlainText', '', Justification = 'Fest vorgegebenes PFX-Passwort von Posh-ACME, die Datei liegt nur fuer Administratoren lesbar in C:\Certificates.')]
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [int] $RetentionDays = 14
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'

$LabRoot = 'C:\ExchangeLab'
$LogDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Logs'
$CertDir = 'C:\Certificates'
$PoshAcmeHome = 'C:\ProgramData\Posh-ACME'
$PfxPassword = 'poshacme'

New-Item -Path $LogDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
$LogFile = Join-Path $LogDir 'Invoke-LabMaintenance.log'

function Write-LabLog {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Message)
    $line = '{0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} {1}' -f (Get-Date), $Message
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line
    Write-Information -MessageData $line -InformationAction Continue
}

function Clear-OldLogFile {
    $paths = @('C:\inetpub\logs\LogFiles')
    $exchangePath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('ExchangeInstallPath', 'Machine')
    if ($exchangePath) {
        $paths += Join-Path $exchangePath 'Logging'
        $paths += Join-Path $exchangePath 'Bin\Search\Ceres\Diagnostics\ETLTraces'
        $paths += Join-Path $exchangePath 'Bin\Search\Ceres\Diagnostics\Logs'
    }

    $cutoff = (Get-Date).AddDays(-$RetentionDays)
    foreach ($path in $paths | Where-Object { Test-Path -Path $_ }) {
        $files = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $path -Recurse -File -Include '*.log', '*.blg', '*.etl' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
                Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -lt $cutoff })
        $bytes = ($files | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
        # Dateien, die gerade geschrieben werden, bleiben einfach stehen.
        $files | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        Write-LabLog ('{0}: {1} Dateien aelter als {2} Tage geloescht ({3:N0} MB).' -f $path, $files.Count, $RetentionDays, ($bytes / 1MB))
    }
}

function Invoke-CertificateRenewal {
    if (-not (Test-Path -Path $PoshAcmeHome) -or -not (Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name Posh-ACME)) {
        Write-LabLog "Kein Posh-ACME eingerichtet, Let's Encrypt wird nicht genutzt."
        return
    }

    $env:POSHACME_HOME = $PoshAcmeHome
    Import-Module -Name Posh-ACME
    $order = Get-PAOrder
    if (-not $order) {
        Write-LabLog 'Kein ACME-Auftrag vorhanden, nichts zu erneuern.'
        return
    }

    # Ohne Faelligkeit liefert Submit-Renewal nichts zurueck und warnt nur.
    $certificate = Submit-Renewal -WarningAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $certificate) {
        Write-LabLog "Zertifikat $($order.MainDomain) noch nicht faellig (Erneuerung ab $($order.RenewAfter))."
        return
    }

    foreach ($file in @($certificate.CertFile, $certificate.KeyFile, $certificate.ChainFile, $certificate.FullChainFile, $certificate.PfxFile, $certificate.PfxFullChain)) {
        if ($file -and (Test-Path -Path $file)) {
            Copy-Item -Path $file -Destination $CertDir -Force
        }
    }
    Write-LabLog "Zertifikat $($order.MainDomain) erneuert (gueltig bis $($certificate.NotAfter)), Dateien nach $CertDir kopiert."

    Add-PSSnapin -Name Microsoft.Exchange.Management.PowerShell.SnapIn
    $pfxFile = Join-Path $CertDir 'fullchain.pfx'
    $x509 = New-Object -TypeName System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2 -ArgumentList $pfxFile, $PfxPassword
    if (-not (Get-ExchangeCertificate | Where-Object { $_.Thumbprint -eq $x509.Thumbprint })) {
        Import-ExchangeCertificate -FileData ([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($pfxFile)) -Password (ConvertTo-SecureString -String $PfxPassword -AsPlainText -Force) -PrivateKeyExportable $true | Out-Null
    }
    Enable-ExchangeCertificate -Thumbprint $x509.Thumbprint -Services 'IIS,SMTP' -Force -Confirm:$false
    Write-LabLog "Neues Zertifikat $($x509.Thumbprint) fuer IIS und SMTP aktiviert."
}

$failed = $false
foreach ($step in 'Clear-OldLogFile', 'Invoke-CertificateRenewal') {
    try {
        & $step
    }
    catch {
        $failed = $true
        Write-LabLog "FEHLER in ${step}: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
}

if ($failed) {
    exit 1
}
Write-LabLog 'Wartung ohne Fehler beendet.'
exit 0

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Richtet den Windows-11-Client des Exchange-Labs ein.

.DESCRIPTION
    Phase 'Prepare' (Azure Managed Run Command als LocalSystem, vor dem Domaenenbeitritt, parallel zum DC-Aufbau):
      - aktive Nutzungszeit 06-23 Uhr per Richtlinie: Windows Update startet waehrend des Aufbaus und
        tagsueber nicht neu, Neustarts fallen auf das abendliche Herunterfahren
      - BlockAADWorkplaceJoin: Die Office-Aktivierung mit dem Firmenkonto registriert den Lab-Client nicht
        im Entra ID der Firma
      - Sprachpaket de-DE als Anzeigesprache, Zeitzone, Gebietsschema, Tastatur
      - Microsoft 365 Apps (de-de, 64 Bit, Monthly Enterprise Channel) per Office Deployment Tool,
        ohne Access, Publisher, Teams, Skype/Lync, Groove und Bing

    Phase 'Complete' (Run Command nach dem Domaenenbeitritt):
      - wartet, bis Domaenenbeitritt und Secure Channel stehen
      - Domaenen-Benutzer in die lokale Gruppe Remotedesktopbenutzer (per SID, unabhaengig von der Sprache)
      - Lab-Info.txt und OWA-Verknuepfung auf dem oeffentlichen Desktop

    Fehler bei Sprachpaket und Office sind nicht fatal: Das Lab bleibt nutzbar, das Log nennt die Ursache.
    Das Skript ist idempotent und enthaelt bewusst nur ASCII-Zeichen (Windows PowerShell 5.1).
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [ValidateSet('Prepare', 'Complete')]
    [string] $Phase = 'Prepare',

    # Nur Phase 'Prepare':
    [ValidateSet('O365ProPlusRetail', 'O365BusinessRetail')]
    [string] $OfficeProductId = 'O365ProPlusRetail',

    # Nur Phase 'Complete':
    [string] $DomainName,
    [string] $NetbiosName,
    [string] $PublicDomainName,
    [string] $FileServerComputerName = ''
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12

$LabRoot = 'C:\ExchangeLab'
$LogDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Logs'
$InstallDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Install'
$OdtDir = Join-Path $InstallDir 'OfficeDeploymentTool'
$OutlookExe = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Microsoft Office\root\Office16\OUTLOOK.EXE'

# Office Deployment Tool, Quelle: Microsoft Download Center (URL und SHA256 aus dem winget-Manifest
# Microsoft.OfficeDeploymentTool, Datei von Microsoft signiert). Beim Aktualisieren beides gemeinsam aendern.
$OfficeDeploymentTool = @{
    Version = '16.0.20430.20146'
    Url     = 'https://download.microsoft.com/download/6c1eeb25-cf8b-41d9-8d0d-cc1dbc032140/officedeploymenttool_20430-20146.exe'
    Sha256  = 'af1594121ab610cd8abc3dd6ff0a504e0cbc6ce54372e5c3813926352d1179c6'
}

New-Item -Path $LogDir, $InstallDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
$LogFile = Join-Path $LogDir "Initialize-LabClient-$Phase.log"

function Write-LabLog {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Message)
    $line = '{0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} [{1}] {2}' -f (Get-Date), $Phase, $Message
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line
    Write-Information -MessageData $line -InformationAction Continue
}

function Invoke-WithRetry {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][scriptblock] $ScriptBlock,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Activity,
        [int] $Attempts = 3,
        [int] $DelaySeconds = 30
    )
    for ($i = 1; $i -le $Attempts; $i++) {
        try {
            return & $ScriptBlock
        }
        catch {
            Write-LabLog "$Activity - Versuch $i/$Attempts fehlgeschlagen: $($_.Exception.Message)"
            if ($i -eq $Attempts) { throw }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds $DelaySeconds
        }
    }
}

function Write-Utf8File {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Path, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Content)
    # Mit BOM, damit Editor und Windows PowerShell 5.1 Umlaute korrekt lesen.
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, (New-Object -TypeName System.Text.UTF8Encoding -ArgumentList $true))
}

#region Phase Prepare

function Initialize-ClientPolicy {
    # Richtlinie "Automatischen Neustart waehrend der Nutzungszeit deaktivieren" (maximal 18 Stunden).
    $updateKey = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate'
    New-Item -Path $updateKey -Force | Out-Null
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $updateKey -Name 'SetActiveHours' -Value 1 -Type DWord
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $updateKey -Name 'ActiveHoursStart' -Value 6 -Type DWord
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $updateKey -Name 'ActiveHoursEnd' -Value 23 -Type DWord
    Write-LabLog 'Aktive Nutzungszeit 06-23 Uhr gesetzt, keine Update-Neustarts in dieser Zeit.'

    # Ohne diesen Schalter bietet Office bei der Anmeldung "Allow my organization to manage my device" an
    # und der Lab-Client landet im Entra ID (ggf. Intune) der Firma.
    $workplaceJoinKey = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WorkplaceJoin'
    New-Item -Path $workplaceJoinKey -Force | Out-Null
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $workplaceJoinKey -Name 'BlockAADWorkplaceJoin' -Value 1 -Type DWord
    Write-LabLog 'Entra-Registrierung des Clients (Workplace Join) blockiert.'
}

function Initialize-ClientLanguage {
    Set-TimeZone -Id 'W. Europe Standard Time'
    try {
        if ((Get-InstalledLanguage -Language de-DE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
            Write-LabLog 'Sprachpaket de-DE bereits installiert.'
        }
        else {
            Write-LabLog 'Installiere Sprachpaket de-DE (dauert einige Minuten).'
            Invoke-WithRetry -Activity 'Install-Language de-DE' -Attempts 2 -DelaySeconds 60 -ScriptBlock {
                Install-Language -Language de-DE -CopyToSettings | Out-Null
            }
        }
        Set-SystemPreferredUILanguage -Language de-DE
        Write-LabLog 'Anzeigesprache de-DE gesetzt, aktiv nach dem Neustart beim Domaenenbeitritt.'
    }
    catch {
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: Sprachpaket de-DE nicht installiert, Oberflaeche bleibt Englisch: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }

    Set-WinSystemLocale -SystemLocale de-DE
    Set-WinHomeLocation -GeoId 94
    Set-Culture -CultureInfo de-DE
    Set-WinUserLanguageList -LanguageList de-DE -Force
    if (Get-Command -Name Copy-UserInternationalSettingsToSystem -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        Copy-UserInternationalSettingsToSystem -WelcomeScreen $true -NewUser $true
    }
    Write-LabLog 'Deutsche Regionaleinstellungen gesetzt.'
}

function Install-OfficeApp {
    if (Test-Path -Path $OutlookExe) {
        Write-LabLog "Microsoft 365 Apps bereits installiert ($OutlookExe)."
        return
    }

    try {
        $odtExe = Join-Path $InstallDir ('officedeploymenttool_{0}.exe' -f $OfficeDeploymentTool.Version)
        Invoke-WithRetry -Activity 'Download Office Deployment Tool' -ScriptBlock {
            Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $OfficeDeploymentTool.Url -OutFile $odtExe -UseBasicParsing
        }
        $hash = (Get-FileHash -Path $odtExe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
        if ($hash -ne $OfficeDeploymentTool.Sha256) {
            Remove-Item -Path $odtExe -Force
            throw "SHA256 des Office Deployment Tool passt nicht (erwartet $($OfficeDeploymentTool.Sha256), erhalten $hash)."
        }

        New-Item -Path $OdtDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
        $extract = Start-Process -FilePath $odtExe -ArgumentList '/quiet', "/extract:`"$OdtDir`"" -Wait -PassThru
        if ($extract.ExitCode -ne 0) {
            throw "Entpacken des Office Deployment Tool mit Exit-Code $($extract.ExitCode) beendet."
        }

        $configuration = @(
            '<Configuration>'
            '  <Add OfficeClientEdition="64" Channel="MonthlyEnterprise">'
            ('    <Product ID="{0}">' -f $OfficeProductId)
            '      <Language ID="de-de" />'
            '      <ExcludeApp ID="Access" />'
            '      <ExcludeApp ID="Bing" />'
            '      <ExcludeApp ID="Groove" />'
            '      <ExcludeApp ID="Lync" />'
            '      <ExcludeApp ID="Publisher" />'
            '      <ExcludeApp ID="Teams" />'
            '    </Product>'
            '  </Add>'
            '  <Property Name="SharedComputerLicensing" Value="0" />'
            '  <Property Name="FORCEAPPSHUTDOWN" Value="TRUE" />'
            '  <Updates Enabled="TRUE" />'
            '  <RemoveMSI />'
            '  <Display Level="None" AcceptEULA="TRUE" />'
            '</Configuration>'
        ) -join "`r`n"
        $configFile = Join-Path $OdtDir 'LabConfiguration.xml'
        Set-Content -Path $configFile -Value $configuration -Encoding UTF8

        Write-LabLog "Installiere Microsoft 365 Apps ($OfficeProductId, de-de, Monthly Enterprise Channel)."
        $setup = Start-Process -FilePath (Join-Path $OdtDir 'setup.exe') -ArgumentList '/configure', "`"$configFile`"" -Wait -PassThru
        if ($setup.ExitCode -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -Path $OutlookExe)) {
            throw "Office-Setup mit Exit-Code $($setup.ExitCode) beendet, Outlook nicht gefunden. Details: C:\Windows\Temp\*.log"
        }
        Write-LabLog 'Microsoft 365 Apps installiert.'
    }
    catch {
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: Microsoft 365 Apps nicht installiert: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $LabRoot 'office-failed.txt') -Value $_.Exception.Message -Encoding ASCII
    }
}

function Invoke-PreparePhase {
    Initialize-ClientPolicy
    Initialize-ClientLanguage
    Install-OfficeApp
}

#endregion

#region Phase Complete

function Wait-DomainJoin {
    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(30)
    while ($true) {
        $computerSystem = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ComputerSystem
        # Der Beitritt ist erst nach dem Neustart der Extension abgeschlossen.
        $joinPending = Test-Path -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Netlogon\JoinDomain'
        $secureChannel = $false
        if ($computerSystem.PartOfDomain -and -not $joinPending) {
            try { $secureChannel = Test-ComputerSecureChannel } catch { $secureChannel = $false }
        }
        if ($secureChannel) {
            Write-LabLog "Domaenenbeitritt zu $($computerSystem.Domain) abgeschlossen, Secure Channel ok."
            return
        }
        if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) {
            throw 'Domaenenbeitritt nach 30 Minuten nicht abgeschlossen.'
        }

    }
}

function Add-DomainUsersToRemoteDesktop {
    # Gruppennamen sind sprachabhaengig (Remotedesktopbenutzer, Domain Users), SIDs nicht.
    $computerAccount = New-Object -TypeName System.Security.Principal.NTAccount -ArgumentList "$NetbiosName\$env:COMPUTERNAME`$"
    $domainSid = $computerAccount.Translate([System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]).AccountDomainSid

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Wartet auf der Exchange-VM, bis der Domain Controller vollstaendig bereit ist.

.DESCRIPTION
    Laeuft als Azure Managed Run Command (LocalSystem) vor dem Domaenenbeitritt.
    Erneuert die DHCP-Lease (neuer DNS-Server aus dem VNet) und prueft in einer Schleife:
      - DNS-Server der VM ist der DC
      - SRV-Record _ldap._tcp.dc._msdcs.<Domain> ist aufloesbar
      - Split-DNS-Record mail.<PublicDomainName> zeigt auf die Exchange-IP (PostReboot-Phase des DC fertig)
      - LDAP-Bind mit dem Domain-Admin funktioniert

    Das Skript enthaelt bewusst nur ASCII-Zeichen (Windows PowerShell 5.1).
#>
[Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSAvoidUsingPlainTextForPassword', 'AdminPasswordB64', Justification = 'Run Command uebergibt Parameter nur als String; Wert ist Base64 und kommt aus protectedParameters.')]
[Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSAvoidUsingUsernameAndPasswordParams', '', Justification = 'Run Command kann keine PSCredential uebergeben.')]
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $DomainName,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $NetbiosName,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $AdminUser,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $AdminPasswordB64,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $DcIp,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $PublicDomainName,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $ExchangeIp,

    [int] $TimeoutMinutes = 45
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'

$LogDir = 'C:\ExchangeLab\Logs'
New-Item -Path $LogDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
$LogFile = Join-Path $LogDir 'Wait-DomainController.log'

function Write-LabLog {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Message)
    $line = '{0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} {1}' -f (Get-Date), $Message
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line
    Write-Information -MessageData $line -InformationAction Continue
}

function Test-DomainControllerReady {
    [Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessageAttribute('PSAvoidUsingPlainTextForPassword', 'Password', Justification = 'DirectoryEntry erwartet das Passwort als String.')]
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Password)

    $dnsServers = (Get-DnsClientServerAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object ServerAddresses).ServerAddresses
    if ($dnsServers -notcontains $DcIp) {
        return "DNS-Server der VM ($($dnsServers -join ', ')) enthaelt den DC $DcIp noch nicht."
    }

    $srv = Resolve-DnsName -Name "_ldap._tcp.dc._msdcs.$DomainName" -Type SRV -DnsOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not ($srv | Where-Object Type -EQ 'SRV')) {
        return "SRV-Record fuer $DomainName noch nicht aufloesbar."
    }

    $mail = Resolve-DnsName -Name "mail.$PublicDomainName" -Type A -Server $DcIp -DnsOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (($mail | Where-Object Type -EQ 'A').IPAddress -notcontains $ExchangeIp) {
        return "Split-DNS-Record mail.$PublicDomainName zeigt noch nicht auf $ExchangeIp."
    }

    # UPN statt NETBIOS\Benutzer: von einem Rechner ausserhalb der Domain scheitert der Bind
    # mit NetBIOS-Praefix gegen den Domain-FQDN (im Testdeployment nachgewiesen).
    $entry = New-Object -TypeName System.DirectoryServices.DirectoryEntry -ArgumentList "LDAP://$DomainName/RootDSE", "$AdminUser@$DomainName", $Password
    try {
        $entry.RefreshCache()
        $namingContext = $entry.Properties['defaultNamingContext'].Value
        if (-not $namingContext) {
            return 'LDAP-Bind liefert keinen Naming Context.'
        }
    }
    catch {
        return "LDAP-Bind als $AdminUser@$DomainName fehlgeschlagen: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
    finally {
        # psbase umgeht den DirectoryEntry-Adapter: Sonst sucht PowerShell "Dispose" als AD-Attribut,
        # bindet dafuer erneut und ueberdeckt bei einem Fehler die eigentliche Meldung.
        try { $entry.psbase.Dispose() } catch { Write-Verbose -Message "Dispose: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    }

    return $null
}

try {
    $password = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($AdminPasswordB64))

    Write-LabLog 'Erneuere DHCP-Lease (DNS-Server aus dem VNet).'
    & ipconfig.exe /renew | Out-Null

    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes($TimeoutMinutes)
    while ($true) {
        Clear-DnsClientCache
        try {
            $reason = Test-DomainControllerReady -Password $password
        }
        catch {
            $reason = $_.Exception.Message
        }

        if (-not $reason) {
            break
        }
        if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) {
            throw "Domain Controller nach $TimeoutMinutes Minuten nicht bereit: $reason"
        }
        Write-LabLog "Warte: $reason"
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 20
    }

    Write-LabLog "Domain Controller fuer $DomainName ist bereit."
    exit 0
}
catch {
    Write-LabLog "FEHLER: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    exit 1
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Richtet den Windows-11-Client des Exchange-Labs ein.

.DESCRIPTION
    Phase 'Prepare' (Azure Managed Run Command als LocalSystem, vor dem Domaenenbeitritt, parallel zum DC-Aufbau):
      - aktive Nutzungszeit 06-23 Uhr per Richtlinie: Windows Update startet waehrend des Aufbaus und
        tagsueber nicht neu, Neustarts fallen auf das abendliche Herunterfahren
      - BlockAADWorkplaceJoin: Die Office-Aktivierung mit dem Firmenkonto registriert den Lab-Client nicht
        im Entra ID der Firma
      - Sprachpaket de-DE als Anzeigesprache, Zeitzone, Gebietsschema, Tastatur
      - Microsoft 365 Apps (de-de, 64 Bit, Monthly Enterprise Channel) per Office Deployment Tool,
        ohne Access, Publisher, Teams, Skype/Lync, Groove und Bing

    Phase 'Complete' (Run Command nach dem Domaenenbeitritt):
      - wartet, bis Domaenenbeitritt und Secure Channel stehen
      - Domaenen-Benutzer in die lokale Gruppe Remotedesktopbenutzer (per SID, unabhaengig von der Sprache)
      - Lab-Info.txt und OWA-Verknuepfung auf dem oeffentlichen Desktop

    Fehler bei Sprachpaket und Office sind nicht fatal: Das Lab bleibt nutzbar, das Log nennt die Ursache.
    Das Skript ist idempotent und enthaelt bewusst nur ASCII-Zeichen (Windows PowerShell 5.1).
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [ValidateSet('Prepare', 'Complete')]
    [string] $Phase = 'Prepare',

    # Nur Phase 'Prepare':
    [ValidateSet('O365ProPlusRetail', 'O365BusinessRetail')]
    [string] $OfficeProductId = 'O365ProPlusRetail',

    # Nur Phase 'Complete':
    [string] $DomainName,
    [string] $NetbiosName,
    [string] $PublicDomainName,
    [string] $FileServerComputerName = ''
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12

$LabRoot = 'C:\ExchangeLab'
$LogDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Logs'
$InstallDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Install'
$OdtDir = Join-Path $InstallDir 'OfficeDeploymentTool'
$OutlookExe = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Microsoft Office\root\Office16\OUTLOOK.EXE'

# Office Deployment Tool, Quelle: Microsoft Download Center (URL und SHA256 aus dem winget-Manifest
# Microsoft.OfficeDeploymentTool, Datei von Microsoft signiert). Beim Aktualisieren beides gemeinsam aendern.
$OfficeDeploymentTool = @{
    Version = '16.0.20430.20146'
    Url     = 'https://download.microsoft.com/download/6c1eeb25-cf8b-41d9-8d0d-cc1dbc032140/officedeploymenttool_20430-20146.exe'
    Sha256  = 'af1594121ab610cd8abc3dd6ff0a504e0cbc6ce54372e5c3813926352d1179c6'
}

New-Item -Path $LogDir, $InstallDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
$LogFile = Join-Path $LogDir "Initialize-LabClient-$Phase.log"

function Write-LabLog {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Message)
    $line = '{0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} [{1}] {2}' -f (Get-Date), $Phase, $Message
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line
    Write-Information -MessageData $line -InformationAction Continue
}

function Invoke-WithRetry {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][scriptblock] $ScriptBlock,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Activity,
        [int] $Attempts = 3,
        [int] $DelaySeconds = 30
    )
    for ($i = 1; $i -le $Attempts; $i++) {
        try {
            return & $ScriptBlock
        }
        catch {
            Write-LabLog "$Activity - Versuch $i/$Attempts fehlgeschlagen: $($_.Exception.Message)"
            if ($i -eq $Attempts) { throw }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds $DelaySeconds
        }
    }
}

function Write-Utf8File {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Path, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Content)
    # Mit BOM, damit Editor und Windows PowerShell 5.1 Umlaute korrekt lesen.
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, (New-Object -TypeName System.Text.UTF8Encoding -ArgumentList $true))
}

#region Phase Prepare

function Initialize-ClientPolicy {
    # Richtlinie "Automatischen Neustart waehrend der Nutzungszeit deaktivieren" (maximal 18 Stunden).
    $updateKey = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate'
    New-Item -Path $updateKey -Force | Out-Null
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $updateKey -Name 'SetActiveHours' -Value 1 -Type DWord
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $updateKey -Name 'ActiveHoursStart' -Value 6 -Type DWord
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $updateKey -Name 'ActiveHoursEnd' -Value 23 -Type DWord
    Write-LabLog 'Aktive Nutzungszeit 06-23 Uhr gesetzt, keine Update-Neustarts in dieser Zeit.'

    # Ohne diesen Schalter bietet Office bei der Anmeldung "Allow my organization to manage my device" an
    # und der Lab-Client landet im Entra ID (ggf. Intune) der Firma.
    $workplaceJoinKey = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WorkplaceJoin'
    New-Item -Path $workplaceJoinKey -Force | Out-Null
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $workplaceJoinKey -Name 'BlockAADWorkplaceJoin' -Value 1 -Type DWord
    Write-LabLog 'Entra-Registrierung des Clients (Workplace Join) blockiert.'
}

function Initialize-ClientLanguage {
    Set-TimeZone -Id 'W. Europe Standard Time'
    try {
        if ((Get-InstalledLanguage -Language de-DE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
            Write-LabLog 'Sprachpaket de-DE bereits installiert.'
        }
        else {
            Write-LabLog 'Installiere Sprachpaket de-DE (dauert einige Minuten).'
            Invoke-WithRetry -Activity 'Install-Language de-DE' -Attempts 2 -DelaySeconds 60 -ScriptBlock {
                Install-Language -Language de-DE -CopyToSettings | Out-Null
            }
        }
        Set-SystemPreferredUILanguage -Language de-DE
        Write-LabLog 'Anzeigesprache de-DE gesetzt, aktiv nach dem Neustart beim Domaenenbeitritt.'
    }
    catch {
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: Sprachpaket de-DE nicht installiert, Oberflaeche bleibt Englisch: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }

    Set-WinSystemLocale -SystemLocale de-DE
    Set-WinHomeLocation -GeoId 94
    Set-Culture -CultureInfo de-DE
    Set-WinUserLanguageList -LanguageList de-DE -Force
    if (Get-Command -Name Copy-UserInternationalSettingsToSystem -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        Copy-UserInternationalSettingsToSystem -WelcomeScreen $true -NewUser $true
    }
    Write-LabLog 'Deutsche Regionaleinstellungen gesetzt.'
}

function Install-OfficeApp {
    if (Test-Path -Path $OutlookExe) {
        Write-LabLog "Microsoft 365 Apps bereits installiert ($OutlookExe)."
        return
    }

    try {
        $odtExe = Join-Path $InstallDir ('officedeploymenttool_{0}.exe' -f $OfficeDeploymentTool.Version)
        Invoke-WithRetry -Activity 'Download Office Deployment Tool' -ScriptBlock {
            Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $OfficeDeploymentTool.Url -OutFile $odtExe -UseBasicParsing
        }
        $hash = (Get-FileHash -Path $odtExe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
        if ($hash -ne $OfficeDeploymentTool.Sha256) {
            Remove-Item -Path $odtExe -Force
            throw "SHA256 des Office Deployment Tool passt nicht (erwartet $($OfficeDeploymentTool.Sha256), erhalten $hash)."
        }

        New-Item -Path $OdtDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null

        if ($extract.ExitCode -ne 0) {
            throw "Entpacken des Office Deployment Tool mit Exit-Code $($extract.ExitCode) beendet."
        }

        $configuration = @(
            '<Configuration>'
            '  <Add OfficeClientEdition="64" Channel="MonthlyEnterprise">'
            ('    <Product ID="{0}">' -f $OfficeProductId)
            '      <Language ID="de-de" />'
            '      <ExcludeApp ID="Access" />'
            '      <ExcludeApp ID="Bing" />'
            '      <ExcludeApp ID="Groove" />'
            '      <ExcludeApp ID="Lync" />'
            '      <ExcludeApp ID="Publisher" />'
            '      <ExcludeApp ID="Teams" />'
            '    </Product>'
            '  </Add>'
            '  <Property Name="SharedComputerLicensing" Value="0" />'
            '  <Property Name="FORCEAPPSHUTDOWN" Value="TRUE" />'
            '  <Updates Enabled="TRUE" />'
            '  <RemoveMSI />'
            '  <Display Level="None" AcceptEULA="TRUE" />'
            '</Configuration>'
        ) -join "`r`n"
        $configFile = Join-Path $OdtDir 'LabConfiguration.xml'
        Set-Content -Path $configFile -Value $configuration -Encoding UTF8

        Write-LabLog "Installiere Microsoft 365 Apps ($OfficeProductId, de-de, Monthly Enterprise Channel)."
        $setup = Start-Process -FilePath (Join-Path $OdtDir 'setup.exe') -ArgumentList '/configure', "`"$configFile`"" -Wait -PassThru

            throw "Office-Setup mit Exit-Code $($setup.ExitCode) beendet, Outlook nicht gefunden. Details: C:\Windows\Temp\*.log"
        }
        Write-LabLog 'Microsoft 365 Apps installiert.'
    }
    catch {
        Write-LabLog "WARNUNG: Microsoft 365 Apps nicht installiert: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $LabRoot 'office-failed.txt') -Value $_.Exception.Message -Encoding ASCII
    }
}

    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(30)

    $lines = @(

      - absichtliche Altlasten aus FileServer.psd1 (Kapitel 8 der Uebungen)
      - einmaliger Update-Task (Update-LabServer.ps1) und Lab-Info.txt auf dem oeffentlichen Desktop
      - optional Task TraineeLab-FileServerResize: verkleinert die VM nach Beispieldokumenten und Updates

    Das Skript ist idempotent und enthaelt bewusst nur ASCII-Zeichen (Windows PowerShell 5.1).

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [ValidateSet('Prepare', 'Complete')]
    [string] $Phase = 'Prepare',

    # Nur Phase 'Prepare':
    [string] $LabUsersB64,
    [string] $FileServerB64,

$LogDir = Join-Path $LabRoot 'Logs'

$LabUsersFile = Join-Path $ScriptDir 'LabUsers.psd1'
$FileServerFile = Join-Path $ScriptDir 'FileServer.psd1'

New-Item -Path $LogDir, $ScriptDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null

function Write-LabLog {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Message)
    $line = '{0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} [{1}] {2}' -f (Get-Date), $Phase, $Message
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line
    Write-Information -MessageData $line -InformationAction Continue
}

function ConvertFrom-Base64String {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Value)
    # loadFileAsBase64 liefert die Datei samt BOM, das Zeichen U+FEFF darf nicht im Inhalt landen.
    [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($Value)).TrimStart([char]0xFEFF)
}

function Invoke-WithRetry {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][scriptblock] $ScriptBlock,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Activity,
        [int] $Attempts = 3,
        [int] $DelaySeconds = 30
    )
    for ($i = 1; $i -le $Attempts; $i++) {
        try {
            return & $ScriptBlock
        }
        catch {
            Write-LabLog "$Activity - Versuch $i/$Attempts fehlgeschlagen: $($_.Exception.Message)"
            if ($i -eq $Attempts) { throw }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds $DelaySeconds
        }
    }
}

function Write-Utf8File {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Path, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Content)
    # Mit BOM, damit Windows PowerShell 5.1 Umlaute korrekt liest.
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, (New-Object -TypeName System.Text.UTF8Encoding -ArgumentList $true))
}

function Invoke-IcaclsCommand {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string[]] $Arguments)
    $output = & icacls.exe @Arguments 2>&1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "icacls $($Arguments -join ' ') endete mit $LASTEXITCODE`: $($output -join ' ')"
    }
}

function Get-LocalizedAccountName {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Sid)
    (New-Object -TypeName System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier -ArgumentList $Sid).Translate([System.Security.Principal.NTAccount]).Value
}

function Get-SharePath {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][hashtable] $Config, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $RelativePath)

function Initialize-DataDisk {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $DriveLetter,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Label
    )

    if (Get-Volume -DriveLetter $DriveLetter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        Write-LabLog "Laufwerk ${DriveLetter}: existiert bereits, Datendisk wird nicht neu formatiert."
        return
    }

    # Ein evtl. vorhandenes DVD-Laufwerk darf den Buchstaben nicht blockieren.
    $cdrom = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Volume -Filter "DriveType = 5 AND DriveLetter = '${DriveLetter}:'"
    if ($cdrom) {
        Write-LabLog "DVD-Laufwerk belegt ${DriveLetter}: und wird nach Z: verschoben."
        Set-CimInstance -InputObject $cdrom -Property @{ DriveLetter = 'Z:' }
    }

    $disk = Get-Disk | Where-Object PartitionStyle -EQ 'RAW' | Sort-Object Number | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $disk) {
        throw 'Keine uninitialisierte Datendisk gefunden.'
    }

    Write-LabLog "Initialisiere Disk $($disk.Number) als ${DriveLetter}: (NTFS, Label $Label)."
    Initialize-Disk -Number $disk.Number -PartitionStyle GPT
    New-Partition -DiskNumber $disk.Number -UseMaximumSize -DriveLetter $DriveLetter | Out-Null
    Format-Volume -DriveLetter $DriveLetter -FileSystem NTFS -NewFileSystemLabel $Label -Confirm:$false | Out-Null
}

function Initialize-RegionalSetting {
    Write-LabLog 'Setze deutsche Regionaleinstellungen (Zeitzone, Gebietsschema, Tastatur).'
    Set-TimeZone -Id 'W. Europe Standard Time'
    Set-WinSystemLocale -SystemLocale de-DE
    Set-WinHomeLocation -GeoId 94
    Set-Culture -CultureInfo de-DE
    Set-WinUserLanguageList -LanguageList de-DE -Force
    if (Get-Command -Name Copy-UserInternationalSettingsToSystem -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        Copy-UserInternationalSettingsToSystem -WelcomeScreen $true -NewUser $true
    }
}

function Initialize-ShareFolder {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][hashtable] $Config)

    New-Item -Path $Config.Root -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
    # Bis zur Phase Complete nur Administratoren und SYSTEM, die Rechte der Abteilungen kommen nach dem Beitritt.
    Invoke-IcaclsCommand -Arguments @($Config.Root, '/inheritance:r', '/grant:r', "*${SidAdministrators}:(OI)(CI)F", "*${SidSystem}:(OI)(CI)F")
    foreach ($folder in $Config.Folders) {
        New-Item -Path (Get-SharePath -Config $Config -RelativePath $folder.Path) -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
    }
    Write-LabLog "Ordnergeruest unter $($Config.Root) angelegt ($($Config.Folders.Count) Ordner)."
}

function Invoke-PreparePhase {
    foreach ($name in 'LabUsersB64', 'FileServerB64') {
        if (-not (Get-Variable -Name $name -ValueOnly)) {
            throw "Parameter $name fehlt (Phase Prepare)."
        }
    }
    Write-Utf8File -Path $LabUsersFile -Content (ConvertFrom-Base64String $LabUsersB64)
    Write-Utf8File -Path $FileServerFile -Content (ConvertFrom-Base64String $FileServerB64)
    $config = Import-PowerShellDataFile -Path $FileServerFile

    Initialize-DataDisk -DriveLetter $config.DriveLetter -Label 'Daten'
    Initialize-RegionalSetting
    Initialize-ShareFolder -Config $config
}
